[[File:CronCluster.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]], an example of a star cluster]]
A '''star cluster''' was a gravitationally-bound group of [[Star/Legends|stars]] that had formed from the same molecular cloud.<ref name="TOTJ">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War 4|''Tales of the Jedi – The Sith War'' 4]]</ref> There were several star clusters in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], including the [[Hapes Cluster/Legends|Hapes]], the [[Plooriod Cluster|Plooriod]], the [[Zeemacht Cluster/Legends|Zeemacht]]<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> and the [[Cron Cluster/Legends|Cron Cluster]].<ref name="TGAotS1">[[Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith 1|''Tales of the Jedi – The Golden Age of the Sith'' 1]]</ref>

Outside the galactic plane on the thick disk, there were globular clusters, formed by hundreds of thousands of stars concentrated within a hundred [[Light-year/Legends|light-year]]. One such distant cluster was the [[Cosm's Well/Legends|Cosm's Well]]. Astronomers identified about two hundred such distant clusters "above" and "below" the disk, and estimated they contained barren and poor worlds, and remained unexplored.<ref name="TEA" />
